digest.component_or_area: Jira write dispatch and retry budget
propositions: Jira writes across multiple retry layers (generic dispatch, Cloud ACLI/REST, DC SDK) can multiply invocations or leave acceptance ambiguous; establish one provider-neutral logical-operation budget with exact summary postcondition validation through both Cloud and DC providers.

Implement a three-invocation, 15-second cumulative sleep budget with exponential backoff [2s,3s) then [4s,5s), respecting provider Retry-After headers as lower bounds, with permanent failures consuming one invocation and transient failures following the shared schedule.

Add an internal constructor-injected route selector (defaulting to legacy in S1, not config/env) to dispatch exact summary-only updates through dedicated Cloud ACLI and DC executor clients with per-call one-attempt no-sleep recovery policies, preserving all other caller behavior.

DC summary-write invocations must be exactly GET→PUT→GET with no hidden repeats; on ambiguous PUT, a separate GET observation consumes the next invocation; satisfied observation returns recovered success without replay.

Map confirmed outcomes to legacy result shapes (preserving _fields_synced, _comment_errors, _subop), record bounded per-mutation terminal dispositions without baseline/provenance advance or S1 deferral, and route commit_unknown/retry_not_before to tagged internal results for S3 terminal consumption.

Emit bounded redacted completion logs for terminal or exhausted outcomes; document the contract, retry ownership, idempotency limits, observe-before-replay discipline, budget lifecycle, rollback strategy, and deltas from prior ADRs in ADR 0100.
